Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.label: Posture up
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.action: Recover posture and clear the triangle entanglement.
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.when_to_use: Before the attacker has secured an effective finishing angle.
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.risk: Posturing without protecting the neck and trapped arm can expose the finish.

Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.label: Stack escape
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.action: Use the authored Stack Escape from Triangle to clear the entanglement and recover top half guard.
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.when_to_use: When the attacker’s alignment allows a controlled stack and leg clearance.
Triangle Choke from Triangle Control.risk: The attacker may switch to the Omoplata.

Armbar from Armbar Control.label: Hitchhiker escape
Armbar from Armbar Control.action: Follow the authored hitchhiker escape path to extract the arm and recover turtle.
Armbar from Armbar Control.when_to_use: When rotational space remains and the arm is not already secured under finishing pressure.
Armbar from Armbar Control.risk: The attacker may follow into a belly-down armbar.

Armbar from Armbar Control.label: Stack escape
Armbar from Armbar Control.action: Protect the arm and use the stack defense to extract it and recover on top.
Armbar from Armbar Control.when_to_use: When forward movement is available without loading the trapped elbow.
Armbar from Armbar Control.risk: The attacker may change the armbar angle or switch submissions.
